Leak detection equipment with maximum performance in a small bench top footprint.
Ease of use and simple validation has led to the global success of Uson’s Sprint series of leak testers. Ideal for the medical industry, Sprint LC and Sprint iQ can perform 13 types of tests for devices such as catheters, tube sets and other medical products. These bench top leak testers can be fully automated if required for the most demanding applications and are available in one, two, three or four channels to suit your needs. Simple to use, they allow for easy, fast setup and operation. With thousands of units installed around the world, Sprint leak testers are the gold standard in the medical device leak testing industry.
